name: Ceruchus piceus
intro: I photographed this small eastern stag beetle in the field.

sections.title: Adults
sections.text: Adults are glossy black to dark reddish brown and measure about 10–14 mm excluding the mandibles. The enlarged male mandibles bear a prominent inner tooth.

sections.title: Host wood
sections.text: Records include decaying beech, birch, black cherry, oak and red pine. For a rearing trial I would retain intact wood and loose material from the occupied log. Pupation has been observed in a decomposing stump.

facts.title: Pupal site
facts.text: Decaying stump in a published field observation
